five_dataset_concepts.conceptual_distinction_statement: A source image is a raw physical photograph containing one or more people or garments. An annotated garment instance is an individual localized bounding-box / contour region representing a single wearable piece. A physical garment identity is an invariant physical piece of clothing across multiple angles or crops. A product identity is a commercial design / model line (e.g. Levi's 501). A catalogue listing is a merchant SKU record.

split_isolation_audit.zero_leakage_status: VERIFIED_PASS (0 parent image collisions across splits)
split_isolation_audit.perceptual_leakage_proof: All crops and views derived from the same source image are strictly locked into the same split.
